title: Places
subtitle: Names on the map that OpenStreetMap does not have: shops, markets, mosques and more. Staff add them from the app; a marker moves only when you approve.
search: Search places by name or note

empty.active: No places yet. Add one, or staff can add them from the app.

moves.title: Place move requests
moves.subtitle: A staff member asked to move these markers. The marker stays where it is until you approve.
moves.emptyBody: When a staff member asks to move a place, it appears here.
moves.mapLabel: Where {{name}} is now and where it should go

form.name: Name shown on the map
form.notePlaceholder: e.g. Blue gate, next to the tea stall

error.outside: This point is outside Bangladesh. Move the map to the right place.

dialog.desc: The name stays next to the marker for everyone, in every branch.
dialog.moveDesc: Move the map until the pin sits on the right spot. The marker moves at once for everyone.
dialog.mapLabel: Map: move it so the pin sits on the place
dialog.moved: {{n}} m from where it is now
dialog.pasteHelp: From Google Maps or a shared location, e.g. 22.16420, 90.42610
dialog.pasteError: Could not read two numbers (latitude, longitude)

toast.approved: {{name}} moved; the staff member is told
toast.rejected: {{name}} stays; the staff member sees your reason

approve.title: Approve this move?
approve.desc: {{name}} moves {{n}} m to the point {{who}} chose. Everyone sees it there from their next sync.

reject.title: Reject this move
reject.desc: {{name}} stays where it is. {{who}} sees your reason.

delete.title: Remove {{name}} from the map?
delete.desc: Nobody sees it on the map any more. It is kept in the history and in the Removed list.
